meta.name: ideal-customer-profile
meta.description: Identify the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) from research data with demographics, behaviors, JTBD, and needs. Use when defining your ICP, analyzing PMF survey data, or understanding who your best customers are.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从调研数据中提炼理想客户画像
copy.tagline_en: Extract ideal customer profiles from research data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define your best customer segments from data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的客户研究数据（如调查、访谈、使用行为等），自动分析并输出一份完整的理想客户画像（ICP），包括公司特征、行为模式、待完成工作（JTBD）、痛点需求、决策流程等，并给出高价值细分和排除标准。
howto.when: 当你需要从产品-市场匹配调查数据中定义ICP、分析高价值客户群体、或评估新客户机会时触发。

say.text: 根据这些客户调查数据，帮我定义理想客户画像。
say.note: Claude 会分析数据并输出完整ICP报告。

say.text: 分析这批高价值客户的共同特征和待完成工作。
say.note: Claude 会提取行为模式和JTBD。

say.text: 从这些流失客户数据中，总结哪些客户不适合我们。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will analyze your customer research data (surveys, interviews, usage behavior, etc.) and automatically output a comprehensive Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) including firmographics, behaviors, Jobs to Be Done, pain points, decision process, and disqualification criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to define ICP from product-market fit survey data, analyze high-value customer segments, or evaluate new customer opportunities for fit.

say_en.text: Based on these customer surveys, help me define the ideal customer profile.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze data and output a full ICP report.

say_en.text: Analyze the common traits and jobs to be done of these high-value customers.
say_en.note: Claude will extract behavior patterns and JTBD.

say_en.text: From this churn data, summarize which customers are not a good fit.
